data.name: Mansour
data.gender_notes: Mansour is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is victorious. Mansour is a name that signifies triumph and success. In the context of Islamic tradition, it is associated with the qualities of a victorious believer. The name Mansour carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mansour usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who achieves spiritual victory through faith and righteousness, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Mansour belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mansour total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: منصور
in_arabic.meaning: المساعد من الله، المنتصر بالعزة والتمكين
in_arabic.long_meaning: منصور هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: المعزز، الممكن، الموفق من الله تعالى، يوحي بالانتصار والتمكين. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'وَيَمُنصُرُكُمُ اللّهُ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ'، الآية 161.

in_urdu.name: منصور
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی مدد سے勝利 حاصل کرنے والا، عزت و تمکین پانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: منصور ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جسے اللہ تعالیٰ کی مدد حاصل ہو، جو عزت و تمکین کا حامل ہو۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मंसूर
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की सहायता से विजयी होने वाला, सम्मान और शक्ति प्राप्त करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मंसूर एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जिसे ईश्वर की सहायता प्राप्त होती है, जो सम्मान और शक्ति का धारक होता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में महत्वपूर्ण है।

in_english.name: Mansour
in_english.meaning: Triumphant, victorious, one who receives help from God
in_english.long_meaning: Mansour is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'the one who is helped by God' or 'triumphant'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-r', which is also found in the Quran, emphasizing divine support and victory. Throughout Islamic tradition, the name signifies strength, divine favor, and steadfastness.

This name is often given to boys in the Muslim world to inspire them with the legacy of their heroic ancestors and to instill a sense of courage, strength, and resilience.
